blocks.title: Software development
body: Software developer with experience in desktop applications, web services and internal tools. I work from requirements definition through testing and maintenance, with a focus on clear code and documentation.

blocks.title: Software developer
body: Fictional team developing management tools for small organisations.
bullets: Developed and maintained Python and SQL applications to query and update operational data.
Designed desktop interfaces and worked with users to review needs and check changes.
Performed integration testing, resolved issues and updated technical documentation.

blocks.title: Software development intern
bullets: Helped maintain HTTP services and SQL queries under team supervision.
Prepared test data, reproduced bugs and documented steps to check fixes.

blocks.title: Higher vocational qualification in Multiplatform Application Development
body: Studied object-oriented programming, relational databases, user interfaces and service access. Final project focused on a local inventory application.

blocks.title: Additional training
body: Practical course in software testing and version control, with exercises in integration testing, documentation and change review.

blocks.title: Inventario Demo
body: Personal inventory application built with Python and SQLite. It supports item registration and stock queries. Cross-device synchronisation is in development and is not yet available.

blocks.title: Cuaderno Local
body: Local note-taking tool with tag-based search and text export. A learning project used to practise separation of responsibilities and service testing.

blocks.title: Technologies and tools
body: Python, SQL, SQLite, Git. Desktop development, HTTP services, integration testing and documentation.

blocks.title: Spanish and English
body: Spanish: native language. English: reading B1, listening B1, writing B1, spoken production and interaction A2. Self-reported levels; no certificate provided.

blocks.title: Working approach
body: Interested in practical tools, maintainable code and continuous learning. Availability and starting arrangements to be agreed.
